fact: In July 2024, 89,579 of the 147,984 households counted in the 2021 census (329,101 people, about 60.5 per cent) were registered in the Cadastro Social Único, the information system used to identify and manage beneficiaries across social programmes.
title: Cadastro Social Único de Cabo Verde: Um instrumento estratégico para o reforço do sistema de proteção social
